evidence.quote: Request a meaningful fee that accounts for the firm's investment, with any fee the court declines to award benefiting the class.
Our opening proposal is $35 million for the class, distributed automatically, plus $10 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses.
any amount the court declines to award would be added to the class fund.
Use differentiated offers to test which counsel can resolve the matter most efficiently.

summary: Counsel exchanged proposals addressing class relief and fees together before Ostrander Bell accepted a complete offer. The proposals expressly directed any unawarded fees to the class, and Whitcombe Reyes privately identified compensation for its investment as a goal. Defense tested different offers across competing counsel and settled with Ostrander Bell; the record does not show a fee-for-lower-fund trade or a misleading declaration.
